survey: A boxy sci-fi control console sits on a riveted metal floor, seen three-quarters from the front left. The light-grey body is a block whose top slopes down toward the viewer. A dark grey control panel is set into the slope, and a raised grey rail runs along its back edge. On the panel are two round gauges at the back left: a white one and a green one, each with a centre pin and a red needle. In front of them are eight round push buttons in two staggered rows of four, alternating red and yellow, each seated in a dark bezel. At the right is a raised dark slot housing that runs along the slope, with a lever in it: a chrome stem with a collar and a red ball knob, rising from a tab that rides in the slot. The front face holds one large inset drawer panel with a single grey bar handle in the middle. The body rests flat on the floor with a contact shadow along its base. The side walls follow the slope and line up with the panel and the back rail.
